verify.summary: Independent AC009 verification: 11 tests, mypy128, lint133 and 100-case baseline differential/selection oracle passed.
Root standalone owner closes AC009 after required independent PASS; future persistence/media/client claims remain in dependent tasks.

constraints: Constitution I/III: implement only the accepted additive delta using existing owners and helpers. No deployment or production probe.
Preserve public phone commons restricted to matched dates; the all-dates rule is Promo-only.
Primary application owner is promo under src/face_moment/promo; inventory and processing expose read-only providers through accepted graph edges. The realtime entrypoint must not own selection.
Reuse the existing farthest-first helper and match ordering; the common provider is bounded to one authoritative venue and remaining capacity <=8. Advisory new filenames may be adjusted by executor.
invariants: The first four teaser IDs, complete union/N, search gates, QR ticket/expiry and ACK semantics remain unchanged.
Commons never make an insufficient personal result successful and never enter union/N.
title: Select the initial optional Promo gallery
purpose: Produce the promo-owned fixed ordered gallery from existing search observations and bounded owner-provided commons.
success_outcome: An independently callable selection returns at most twelve unique typed gallery entries, preserving the four teasers and union/N and filling only remaining places with eligible same-venue commons.
anti_goals: No persistence, realtime response integration, HTTP gallery-media route or browser change.
No new inference, search, derivative generation, background work or public-phone scope expansion.

forbidden_scope: Session schema/publication and gallery HTTP media
Client display/configuration and public-phone date semantics
stop_conditions: Selection requires a new ownership edge or a product decision beyond Optional Second Slide.

verification_targets: FT-004-AC-009: use existing match observations with ties, repeated IDs, >12 and 4..11 union members; compare exact order and unchanged four teasers/union/N. Include <4 personal matches plus many commons, proving no success rescue.

FT-004-AC-009: disposable PostgreSQL seeded across venues/dates/visibility/states proves public owner reads return only active same-venue no_faces commons, stable photo_id order, limit at most eight/remaining capacity, and zero writes. Existing phone provider retains its matched-date filter. Reuse tests/disposable_postgresql.py and verify teardown; repeat produces the same results.
